item.title: 【Requests】[REQ VID] - Fool Canada (2015 CBC hidden prank show with Will Sasso)
item.description:
Starring comedic talent Will Sasso, Fool Canada is a fun and witty social experiment series that tests Canadians' notorious politeness, patience and gullibility. Armed with a truckload of hidden cameras and devious disguises, Sasso and a team of comedians poke fun at what it means to be Canadian.

Starring Carig Lauzon, Sara Hennessey, Sam Kalilieh. Also featuring Nigel Downer, Jamillah Ross, Sandy Jobin-Bevans, Marty Adams, Lisa Brooke, Darren Keay and Cory Bowles.
Click to expand...
I've been trying to track down this hard to find hidden prank show that Will Sasso hosted on CBC back in the Summer 2015, but it appears that it was currently in lost media nowadays. This show was used to be available on iTunes and Google Play in Canada, but it was delisted as CBC lost the rights to it. Same goes with their streaming service CBC Gem (originally watch.cbc.ca and the CBC TV app until it was rebranded to CBC Gem in 2018) which was removed either 2020 or 2021 for the same story.

I only have the first episode in 720p that's currently on BTN but the season pack for both 720p and 1080p seems to be lost. I could identify these (if anyone has those):

"Fool.Canada.S01.PDTV.x264-JIVE"
"Fool.Canada.S01.720p.CBC.WEBRip.DD5.1.H.264-RTN"
"Fool.Canada.S01.1080p.CBC.WEBRip.DD5.1.H.264-RTN"

There's some info of this show if you're interested:
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fool_Canada
https://web.archive.org/web/20150702134243/http://shaftesbury.ca/fool-canada/
https://web.archive.org/web/20150623234602/http://www.cbc.ca/foolcanada/

Thanks!
